notes.title: 🤖 A-RED Walking Robot launches a demo at Steam Next Fest! 🚀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748864/6c05201ac28e3f45d70d14e95c49db900f91c5eb.png[/img]

📢 Attention, wind-up robot pilots! A-RED Walking 🤖 Robot joins Steam Next Fest with a new free demo for you to test and challenge your robotic skills.

🗓️ When: From February 24 at 19:00 (CET) to March 3.

🔥 What’s this all about?
Imagine being the proud pilot of A-RED, a small wind-up robot with a big attitude and tireless little legs. 💨 Your mission: overcome challenges, dodge traps 🕹️⚡, and solve puzzles in the mysterious laboratory of its creator 🏭🔧. All with a retro, colorful, and 90s nostalgia-filled style.

🔴 Why play the demo?
[list]
[*] Because wind-up robots are awesome.
[*] Because the puzzles and platforming are challenging yet fair (we promise 🤞).
[*] Because if you find bugs, you can help us fix them and make history in robotic science.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=d6KPlhUX_lE;full][/previewyoutube]

✨ Don’t let A-RED walk alone! Try the demo at Steam Next Fest and add it to your wishlist.✨
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713980/ARED_Walking_Robot_Demo?snr=1_5_9__18

notes.title: Don't miss A-Red's robotic show at the INDIE Live Expo on May 25!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748864/a62d558d30c6b4e275e126d4119b6551c1104f9f.png[/img]

[b]🌟 The most fun toy Robot Simulator is ready to conquer the hearts of all humans! 🌟[/b]

Don't miss A-Red's robotic show at the [url=https://indie.live-expo.games/en/]INDIE Live Expo[/url] on May 25! 

[i]Get ready to discover this exciting adventure with A-RED, the little wind-up robot who will make you live unforgettable moments! 🤖✨ If you haven't yet tried the demo of this cool physics-based simulator, the INDIE Live Expo is the perfect place to do so.

Every challenge is a new opportunity to show off your skill and creativity! From ingenious and tricky obstacles to surprising puzzles, A-RED needs your ingenuity to advance 🎮🛠️ Help him complete the demo, we assure you he'll catch you until the end! [/i]

Are you ready to help [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2659840/ARED_Walking_Robot/]A-RED Walking Robot[/url]?

[list]
[*] Immerse yourself in this toy world full of color and fantasy, where physics and fun combine to offer you a unique experience. 🌈🔧
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748864/6d974ee542432a9c043c3aa07d4524c0741287bb.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Dare to pilot A-RED by land and air to discover all the surprises that await you in the fantastic and chaotic workshop 🚀🌟
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748864/efa80a855fb1ee04f598e686733de0d1796db2a5.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Run through the levels of A-RED Walking Robot accompanied by Atsushi Moriya's soundtrack! 🎵🤖
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748864/a484a147b8eec4623eb30bd6d076143fd8e5c794.gif[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/live/FMEflpy4t0g]We'll be waiting for you together with the endearing robot A-RED at the INDIE Live Expo! [/url]👋
